title: 大学英语四级核心词 (CET-4)
description: 四级高频考点词汇，涵盖阅读与写作高频出现词

words.translation: vt. 放弃，遗弃；n. 放任，放肆
words.example: They had to abandon the plan due to bad weather.
words.exampleTrans: 由于恶劣的天气，他们不得不放弃该计划。

words.translation: n. 能力，才智；能耐
words.example: She has an extraordinary ability to solve complex problems.
words.exampleTrans: 她具有解决复杂问题的非凡能力。

words.translation: adj. 绝对的；完全的；确定无疑的
words.example: I have absolute confidence in your ability.
words.exampleTrans: 我对你的能力有着绝对的信心。

words.translation: adj. 学术的；理论的；高等院校的
words.example: He achieved high academic honors at university.
words.exampleTrans: 他在大学里获得了很高的学术荣誉。

words.translation: n. 障碍，屏障；栅栏；阻碍
words.example: Language should not be a barrier to communication.
words.exampleTrans: 语言不应成为沟通的障碍。

words.translation: n. 战役；运动，竞选活动；vi. 领导运动
words.example: They launched a campaign to protect the environment.
words.exampleTrans: 他们发起了一场保护环境的运动。

words.translation: n. 候选人；应试者；申请求职者
words.example: He is the best candidate for this position.
words.exampleTrans: 他是这个职位的最佳人选。

words.translation: adj. 蓄意的，存心的；慎重的；v. 仔细考虑
words.example: It was a deliberate attempt to mislead the public.
words.exampleTrans: 这是蓄意误导公众的企图。

words.translation: adj. 效率高的，有能力的
words.example: We need to find a more efficient way to process data.
words.exampleTrans: 我们需要找到一种更有效率的数据处理方法。

words.translation: vt. 迷住，使着迷；强烈吸引
words.example: Science and technology fascinate young generations.
words.exampleTrans: 科学与技术深深吸引着年轻一代。

words.translation: vt. 保证，担保；n. 保证书；担保物
words.example: Hard work doesn't always guarantee success, but it helps.
words.exampleTrans: 努力不一定能保证成功，但总是有帮助的。

words.translation: vt. 强调，突出；n. 最精彩的部分
words.example: The report highlighted the importance of digital literacy.
words.exampleTrans: 该报告强调了数字素养的重要性。

words.translation: adj. 巨大的，广大的；极大的
words.example: The project required an immense amount of time and effort.
words.exampleTrans: 该项目需要耗费大量的时间和精力。

words.translation: vt. 证明…是正当的；为…辩护
words.example: Nothing can justify such rude behavior.
words.exampleTrans: 没有什么能为如此无礼的行为辩护。

words.translation: adj. 热心的，渴望的；敏锐的；激烈的
words.example: She has a keen interest in modern architecture.
words.exampleTrans: 她对现代建筑有着浓厚的兴趣。

words.translation: v. 发射；发动；发起；推出；n. 发射；投放市场
words.example: The company plans to launch a new product next month.
words.exampleTrans: 该公司计划下个月推出一款新产品。

words.translation: vt. 维持，保持；坚持；主张；维修，保养
words.example: It is vital to maintain a positive attitude under stress.
words.exampleTrans: 在压力下保持积极的心态至关重要。

words.translation: v. 谈判，协商；商定，达成协议
words.example: The union is negotiating for higher wages and better benefits.
words.exampleTrans: 工会正在谈判以争取更高的工资和更好的福利。

words.translation: n. 障碍，绊脚石；妨碍
words.example: Fear of failure is the greatest obstacle to success.
words.exampleTrans: 对失败的恐惧是成功最大的障碍。

words.translation: vi. 坚持不懈，百折不挠
words.example: If you persevere with your studies, you will surely succeed.
words.exampleTrans: 如果你坚持不懈地学习，你一定会成功的。
